Emily, Marcus — quick privacy analysis after initial triage:

1) DPA / SCCs: Redwood's standard DPA is compatible with MedTechX requirements; we can accept controller-to-processor SCCs and propose a standard clause set. Legal needs to review a copy of your requested DPA text for any bespoke changes.

2) SCCs for EU transfers: we support SCCs; if MedTechX insists on vendor-specific (customer-agreed) variants we'll need redlines but the baseline is supported.

3) HIPAA / BAA feasibility:
- We can support PHI under a formal BAA but only on Private deployment (customer VPC or Dedicated Reserved capacity) or a specific hosted arrangement with documented data separation.
- Operational controls required: VPC-only egress controls, customer-managed encryption keys (KMS/HSM), and audit log retention 7+ years (if required).
- Not feasible on vanilla shared hosted tenancy due to multi-tenant telemetry and limited contractual isolation.

4) Evidence notes: we can provide SOC 2 Type II (June 2026) — link included, encryption-at-rest documentation (AES-256 with KMIP/HSM options), and sample logging extracts. For HIPAA we will need the planned data flows and expected retention to confirm any additional engineering work.

Next steps I propose:
- Emily: please send a short data flow diagram that shows types of data to be stored/processed, jurisdiction(s), and whether PHI will traverse Redwood-hosted queues.
- Marcus/Rishi: we'll prepare the SIG answers for the privacy sections and package the evidence index for legal review by 2026-10-14.

-Neha Kapoor
Privacy Lead, Redwood Inference
